panels.description: Total gRPC request volume across all services, from the freebusy_rpc_requests_total counter emitted by every handler.
panels.title: Request Rate

panels.description: Share of requests that are server faults (Internal/Unknown/Unavailable/DeadlineExceeded/DataLoss) — expected client rejections like NotFound are excluded by the observer.
panels.title: Error Rate

panels.description: Sum of in-use Postgres connections across instances matching $property. No-op (stays at 0) when the provider is Hasura, since the pool monitor only samples the GORM connection.
panels.title: DB Connections In Use

panels.description: GORM provider only — a Hasura-backed deployment has no SQL connection pool to report on, so this stays at 0 there by design.
panels.title: DB Pool Utilization

panels.description: Share of GORM queries (SQL-level, via the gorm plugin) completing with an error, excluding plain not-found.
panels.title: GORM Query Error Rate

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (service) (rate(freebusy_rpc_errors_total{service=~"$service", property=~"$property"}[5m])) / sum by (service) (rate(freebusy_rpc_requests_total{service=~"$service", property=~"$property"}[5m]))

panels.description: No RPC latency histogram is exported to Prometheus, so this reads span duration percentiles directly from Tempo via TraceQL metrics (quantile_over_time).
panels.title: Span Duration Percentiles (p50 / p90 / p99)

panels.description: Traces with a root span over 1s — a starting point for investigating tail latency.
panels.title: Slow Traces (> 1s)

panels.description: Postgres pool levels (GORM provider only). Open/InUse/Idle are gauges sampled every 30s by the pool monitor; Max Open is the configured bound, shown dashed for reference.
panels.title: Connection Pool Levels

panels.description: Rate of callers queueing for a connection because the pool is saturated. A rising rate here means traffic has outgrown max_open_conns.
panels.title: Pool Wait Events / sec

panels.description: SQL-level query rate per table, from the gorm plugin (every Create/Query/Update/Delete/Row/Raw callback). GORM provider only — there is no equivalent SQL layer on the Hasura path; see "Store Ops Rate by Table + Operation" for the repository-level view that covers both providers.
panels.title: GORM Query Rate by Table

panels.description: GORM provider only — SQL-level errors from the gorm plugin. The Hasura path has no equivalent SQL layer.
panels.title: GORM Query Error Rate by Table

panels.description: GORM provider only — histogram buckets come from the gorm plugin's SQL-level instrumentation. The Hasura path has no equivalent SQL layer; use the Store Op Duration panel for a cross-provider view at the repository level.
panels.title: GORM Query Duration (SQL-level)

panels.description: Repository-level operations (one per store method call), from freebusy_orm_store_ops_total. Covers both providers: GORM's generated stores and the hand-written Hasura repositories (booking, property, promocode) via internal/database/hasura/graphqlx — a given deployment only runs one provider at a time, so series never actually mix.
panels.title: Store Ops Rate by Table + Operation

panels.description: Repository-level operation duration from freebusy_orm_store_duration_ms. Covers both providers (see the Store Ops Rate panel above).
panels.title: Store Op Duration p95 by Table

panels.description: Repository-level operations, avg duration over the last 5m. Covers both providers.
panels.title: Slowest Tables (avg op duration, 5m)

panels.description: Hold sweeper runs a minute, by outcome. Errors mean lapsed holds stay ACTIVE in list views until a run succeeds (reads are unaffected).
panels.title: Hold Sweeper Runs

panels.description: Lapsed holds the sweeper marked EXPIRED, a minute.
panels.title: Holds Expired / min

panels.description: Delivery attempts a minute: succeeded, retrying (failed, will retry) and failed (gave up after max_attempts).
panels.title: Webhook Attempts

panels.description: From a delivery being recorded to its endpoint accepting it. Retries show up as a long tail.
panels.title: Webhook Delivery Lag
